description: Canonical registry of Cokret-defined MLS (RFC 9420) GroupContext extensions occupying the MLS private-use ExtensionType range 0xF000-0xFFFF. Maintained so SDKs and conformance tooling have a single machine-readable entry for each Cokret MLS extension codepoint, preventing collisions between future Cokret extensions in the private-use range and recording any future migration to an IANA standard codepoint.

private_use_range.reference: RFC 9420 §17.6; IANA MLS Extension Types registry (private-use range)

extensions.name: mls_governance_binding
extensions.carries: Cokret Realm/Circle governance binding inside the MLS GroupContext
extensions.migration: If a network-wide registration is ever required, request a standard codepoint via the IETF MLS extensions registry (specification-required) and declare it in a new hardening profile as a separate wire version; do not override this binding with another codepoint inside v1. Target alignment (2026-06 review): restate governance_binding against the draft-ietf-mls-extensions Safe Extension API (safe GroupContext component semantics + IANA safe labels + LeafNode safe_extensions capability signal) so its security argument can ride the framework's generic analysis; after RFC, request both the standard codepoint and a safe label, and review Cokret exporter labels (e.g. ck-rtc-frame-key/v1) against the IANA label registration discipline. If the binding proves fully expressible as a safe GroupContext component, switching the wire form is a v2-cycle decision, not a v1 change.
